relations.text: 医療用部品の供給元。Intuitive Surgicalの子会社がUFPの2025年売上の約24.3%を占める
relations.text_en: Medical component supplier; an Intuitive Surgical subsidiary was about 24.3% of UFP’s 2025 net sales

source.label: UFP Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Two customers (Intuitive Surgical SARL and Stryker) comprised approximately 24.3% and 21.5%, respectively, of our net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025

relations.text: 中国で手術支援ロボットを販売する合弁会社を復星医薬と運営(Intuitiveが過半を保有)
relations.text_en: Runs majority-owned joint ventures with Fosun Pharma that sell its systems in China

source.label: Intuitive Surgical 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: China (through our majority-owned joint ventures, Intuitive Surgical-Fosun Medical Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Intuitive Surgical-Fosun (HongKong) Co. Ltd. (collectively, the "Joint Venture"), with Fosun Pharma)

relations.text: 手術支援ロボットや器具で競合する大手医療機器メーカー
relations.text_en: A large medical device maker competing in surgical robots and instruments

source.label: Intuitive Surgical 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we face greater competition from larger and well-established companies, such as Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic plc.
